entities.name: Toshi Umezawa
entities.description: A rogue warrior in Princess Michiko's employ and acolyte of the Myojin of Night's Reach who gains the Yuki-Onna's frost power and the Shadow Gate's teleportation.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: Princess of Eiganjo, put under house arrest, later teleported out by Toshi and brought to Minamo.

entities.name: Takeshi Konda
entities.description: Michiko's father, ruler of Eiganjo, who summons Yosei and faces O-Kagachi's attack.

entities.name: Lady Pearl-Ear
entities.description: A kitsune imprisoned and then exiled from Eiganjo who leads a diplomatic delegation to Minamo.

entities.name: Sharp-Ear
entities.description: Pearl-Ear's brother who informs her the kitsune live in the forest.

entities.name: Captain Nagao
entities.description: A captain who survived with some soldiers.

entities.name: Boss Uramon
entities.description: A crime lord who tries to recruit Toshi and sends thugs after him; he is killed by Toshi.

entities.name: Kiku
entities.description: A thug sent by Uramon who is forced into the Hyozan Reckoners.

entities.name: Marrow-Gnawer
entities.description: A thug sent by Uramon who is forced into the Hyozan Reckoners.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: An ogre who seeks vengeance for Kobo, abducted the Yamabushi apprentices and attacks Minamo.

entities.name: Choryu
entities.description: A prisoner pinned alive on Hidetsugu's wall, mercy killed by Toshi.

entities.name: Yuki-Onna
entities.description: An ice spirit whose frost power Toshi gains and who is later cracked free by Godo to lure soldiers to death.

entities.name: Myojin of Night's Reach
entities.description: A spirit whom Toshi serves and who gives him the Shadow Gate's power and later calls in his debt.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: A spirit beast that eats Konda's divisions and attacks Eiganjo.

entities.name: Yosei, the Morning Star
entities.description: A spirit dragon summoned by Konda to protect Eiganjo, bitten in half by O-Kagachi.

entities.name: Godo
entities.description: A bandit lord who receives the Yuki-Onna plate from Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Mochi
entities.description: A soratami who launches an armada on Jukai and admits the soratami plan to conquer Kamigawa.

entities.name: Iki Hisoka
entities.description: A figure at Minamo who talks with the kitsune delegation.

entities.name: Chiyo
entities.description: A soratami who attacked Toshi and has her face mauled by an oni.

entities.name: Keiga, the Tide Star
entities.description: Minamo's guardian, killed by Hidetsugu's forces.

entities.name: Munetsugu Takeno
entities.description: A defender who dies shielding Konda from debris and rises as a misshapen ghost.

entities.name: Isamaru
entities.description: A creature released by Takeno who rallies the soldiers.

entities.name: Captain Okazawa
entities.description: The injured captain leading soldiers who escorted refugees.

entities.name: That Which Was Taken
entities.description: A being, in a way a daughter of O-Kagachi, taken by Konda; Toshi uses it to make O-Kagachi disappear.

entities.name: Hyozan Reckoners
entities.description: A group Toshi belongs to and into which he forces Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer.

entities.name: Eiganjo
entities.description: The castle city of the Kondas, attacked by O-Kagachi.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: The academy attacked by Hidetsugu.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane engulfed by the Kami War.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war threatening to engulf Kamigawa.

entities.name: Towabara
entities.description: A region on whose border the Yuki-Onna is released.

events.summary: Toshi goes to the Heart of Frost, gains the Yuki-Onna's frost power and captures her in a magic disk, forcing Kiku and Marrow-Gnawer into the Hyozan Reckoners.
events.quote: then succeeds in gaining the Onna's power of frost and capturing her in a magic disk via a kanji ritual.

events.summary: Hidetsugu plans to raze Minamo and Otawara; Toshi persuades him to attack Jukai first, and they trade items.
events.quote: Toshi convinces Hidetsugu that he needs more time and tells him to attack Jukai first.

events.summary: Pearl-Ear is exiled from Eiganjo, finds her village burned by the akki army and learns the kitsune have severed ties with Konda.
events.quote: The kitsune have severed their ties with Konda as he clearly can't protect them anymore.

events.summary: Hidetsugu gives the Yuki-Onna plate to Godo, who cracks it at the border with Towabara and she lures soldiers to death.
events.quote: The Yuki-Onna starts luring soldiers to their deaths.

events.summary: Toshi goes through the Shadow Gate and barters with Night's Reach for teleportation power, kills Uramon, teleports Michiko to Pearl-Ear and mercy kills Choryu.
events.quote: Toshi also teleports to Hidetsugu's lair and mercy kills Choryu despite knowing it would enrage Hidetsugu.

events.summary: O-Kagachi attacks Eiganjo and the refugees run into the akki army.
Michiko speaks with Mochi at Minamo, learning what her father took was a daughter of O-Kagachi, as Toshi learns the soratami plan to conquer Kamigawa and Hidetsugu attacks Minamo.
events.quote: Then suddenly the academy is rocked as Hidetsugu attacks.

events.summary: Hidetsugu's forces kill Keiga; at Eiganjo O-Kagachi bites Yosei in half and Takeno dies protecting Konda; Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken, making O-Kagachi disappear.
events.quote: Toshi grabs That Which Was Taken and teleports out, making O-Kagachi disappear.

events.summary: Toshi freezes Mochi and drops the Taken One at his feet, hoping Konda, O-Kagachi and Hidetsugu will fight over it, then teleports Michiko's party back to Jukai.
events.quote: Back at Minamo he freezes Mochi with his ice powers and drops the Taken One at his feet

events.summary: Isamaru and the wounded Yosei rally the soldiers while an army of twisted ghosts led by a misshapen Takeno rises to aid Konda.
events.quote: the appearance of Isamaru and the hurt-but-still-fighting Yosei rallies them.

events.summary: Night's Reach calls in Toshi's debt and has him leave the Hyozan Reckoners, though his intentions secretly diverge from hers.
events.quote: Night's Reach cashes in on the favor Toshi owes her.

relations.quote: beholden to the Myojin of Night's Reach
Now in the employ of Princess Michiko
Konda is planning to send troops to look for his missing daughter

relations.note: He kills her after following her to the Shadow Gate.
relations.quote: After killing Uramon, Kiku and Marrow go lie low.

relations.note: O-Kagachi bites Yosei in half; Yosei keeps fighting.
relations.quote: There O-Kagachi bites Yosei clean in half and attacks the tower.

relations.note: Hidetsugu attacks the academy seeking vengeance for Kobo.
relations.quote: to raze the Minamo academy to the ground
